uploads.title: Taiwan’s Silicon Shield: The $5 Trillion War Deterrent #Shorts

learnings: Hook the viewer within the first 3 seconds using high-stakes numbers or compelling geopolitical maps.
Include high-impact financial or strategic figures in the title (e.g., '$5 Trillion', 'Monopoly Tech').
Keep Short titles punchy and place hashtags like #Shorts in the description or tags rather than cluttering the main title.
Maintain high visual density with fast-paced B-roll, maps, and dynamic text overlays for maximum retention.
Combine tech, economics, and military strategy to broaden the documentary appeal beyond standard news.
Add a compelling end-screen CTA or verbal cue to convert passive viewers into subscribers.

The hidden vulnerability of global undersea internet cables

China's chokehold on rare earth metal supply chains
avoid: Relying on static text-heavy slides without dynamic movement or voiceover
Generic academic titles lacking curiosity or high-stakes framing
Publishing sporadically without testing different thumbnail and hook variations
Assuming organic reach will trigger without optimizing description tags and keywords
